---
title: "1. Variables & Basic Types"
description: "Learn R variable assignment and basic types (numeric, character, logical) with live, editable R code."

  show-startup-message: false

In R, you create a variable with the assignment arrow `<-` (an equals sign `=` also works). R has a few core types: numeric, character (text), and logical (`TRUE`/`FALSE`). Use `class()` to check a value's type.

```{=html}
<div class="sm-discuss">
  <p class="sm-discuss-label"><i class="fa-solid fa-comments"></i>Discuss first</p>
  <p>Before you run the code below: <code>is_student</code> is assigned <code>TRUE</code>. What do you think <code>class(is_student)</code> would print? Is <code>TRUE</code> the same kind of value as <code>25</code> or as <code>"Ada"</code>?</p>
</div>
```

Edit the code below if you like, then press **Run Code** to check your answer.

```{webr-r}
age <- 25
name <- "Ada"
is_student <- TRUE

age
class(age)
class(name)
```
